lastCompletedAction: Repository-controlled FOUND-003 finished. Migration 0074 resolves the RECEIVING company from channel_accounts (DEFAULT_COMPANY_ID deleted; an unattributable message is not processed at all, and the documented single-tenant bridge closes the moment a second company or any mapping exists). Migration 0075 turns recordForReview into a real capability-gated queue with an audited, database-re-checked resolution RPC, and /app/admin/inbound-review is the surface a person opens. The durable Inngest worker now uses the SAME dispatcher as the request path — with WHATSAPP_ASYNC on it previously called the customer order handler directly, so identity routing did not apply. Provider failures are now classified transient / permanent / not-configured, with a send timeout, so a missing credential no longer consumes the retry budget and a permanent rejection is not retried eight times.
